Kriegsmark, Captain's cabin

"Well, that certainly was fun as hell," Stan said with a big grin as he stretched out.

While he didn't get any work done that day, their visitors were quite the pleasant distraction and he no longer felt like he needed to worry about them showing up in the night. They did reveal some of the political landscape though, Jhoka's Nine Lodge Clan was currently at war with the southern tribes of the "old order" that Inzili was quite familiar with. Fortunately the ship was parked squarely in the middle of their territory which hadn't seen many raiders or war parties. Stan had cleared out the cargo hold of some of his more useless junk that would be a great help to Jhoka's clan, obsolete armor and equipment that was lightyears ahead of anything the primitive tribal society could produce.

Jade walked in and discarded her towel before she sat down on the bed, her plump, naked figure barely jiggling as she crawled up and over him. Both children were in the other cabin being tucked in by Inzili, who could be heard saying sweet things to the toddlers over the baby monitor. Even though they had just enjoyed a vigorous session in the shower he still admired her curves and watched the muscles in her back flex as she wiggled closer to him.

"I love this thing," Jade said, her sharp teeth gleaming in the moonlight as she listened to Inzili, "she sounds happy."

"Yep, real big change of pace, let's hope it sticks."

"Mmm, baby I don't think she could be unhappy after what you did in the shower," she murmured, smiling up at him as she slid her hand down his abdomen and wrapping her claws around the appendage. "Oh! Sorry baby, didn't mean to-"

When she didn't let go he sighed and carefully shifted himself. "Jade if you don't mind, I think I'm done for tonight."

"Really? You're kidding, right?" she giggled, looking up and down his body. Then she saw all the claw marks, the red streaks of clots that were thin and gummy from the shower's moisture. "Holy shit, we did that?"

"Like is this your first time noticing or what?"

They had been together for three years, of course she noticed when the sex got a little rough; she had her own marks here and there from Inzili's sharp claws. However she was never responsible for inflicting them herself, at least not that she knew of, but she could see her own handiwork all over his sides and shoulders. Not deep of course, that was always the work of the purple dragon they lived with, but she felt a flush of embarrassment and shame from it.

"Baby I am so sorry. I didn't know."

Stan shrugged and rolled over on his back, letting the terrible lacerations get some air. "Jade, if it was a problem do you think I'd have kept quiet for this long?"

"Yes, you stubborn ass," she muttered, leaning down to kiss his neck. "Wow, this one on your shoulder is... like really deep. It looks serious."

Saying that could mean any number of things, Inzili had a tendency to claw and knead which often drove them deeper in one place, sometimes she did it in her sleep to both of them and it could make things difficult. Most of the time it was benign and just dented his skin, but there had been times when he woke up soaked in blood which often made her keep from touching either of them for a week. Though during other activities she sometimes would rake her claws into his flesh and in the height of passion she often drew a little blood, a few times it became alarming and one time required immediate medical attention. He was covered in scars anyway and had an incredible tolerance for pain, and when it happened he was always far too preoccupied to care.

When the perpetrator walked in she saw the criss-crossed red slashes on his back and stopped, flicking on the light. "Is it bad this time?"

"Please, don't-"

"Zili, like... maybe we should dull your claws or something. We can't keep hurting him like this."

Dull her claws? That seemed excessive, but she glanced down at them and admittedly they were very sharp looking. "Do you think so? Teekus, do you want this?"

What he wanted probably wasn't on the goddamn agenda for tonight. "Can you both do me a really big favor?"

Both his lovers sat on either side and waited, he made it seem like he was deep in thought but instead he counted off the seconds. Not exactly honest of him, but they were on the cusp of what he called a "batshit crazy loop." They bounced something back and forth until it passed the boundary of all reason, it was annoying and it was distracting from more important things; he couldn't afford distractions anymore. Somehow he had lucked out and found himself in a relationship with two people who had the perfect personalities for that, independently they were manageable but ever since their pregnancies they reminded him of a pair of hens making noise for the hell of it.

"I know both y'all really mean well, I do, but right now I just-"

"Teekus this is serious, look at these, this one needs attention right away. How can you let me lick this clean? That's unsanitary, not good, you get infection from this and then you get sick."

Except for the fact that her saliva was geared specifically for licking him clean after mauling the fuck out of him, sure, maybe she had a point. Out of all the responses he could have come up with, nothing really seemed like a good idea. Reason was out the window, they needed to feel helpful and he recognized that.

"You know what? Fine, you're right, I do need a little takin' care of so how bout you make it up to me?"

"That's fair, we kinda, uh..." Jade trailed off and looked over his lacerations. "Yeah, I'm just sorry that happened. Sex was fantastic, but wow we really did... yeah. Wow."

"We all got a little rough. How 'bout a massage and we just go to sleep? I'd really like that." Especially that last part, he thought. "Sound good?"

"Really? That's all you want?" she asked with growing suspicion. "Nothing else?"

"Honey, my muscles really ache right now. Think you can fix that?"

Jade sat back and looked up at Inzili who shared her surprised and confused expression, but a few moments later she picked up the bottle of massage oil and examined the label.

"'Non-toxic, rejuvenating formula, safe for sunburns to provide a cool relief to irritation,'" she read off aloud, turning the bottle to see any additional warnings. "Mmm... ingredients... instructions... Oh, you're not supposed to swallow it."

"Jade, this serious, we won't feed it to him," Inzili scolded as she slid over on top of him. "Teekus, are you hungry? Can we get you anything?"

Oh for fuck's sake! Stan buried his annoyance and smiled, knowing they were only trying to help. "I'm full... Hey, I love you."
